term.oav: OAV (odor activity value): the concentration of a compound divided by its odor threshold. A value above 1 is generally taken to mean that it contributes to the overall odor.
term.roav: ROAV (relative odor activity value): the compound with the highest OAV is set to 100 and the others are scaled in proportion, to compare the relative contributions of the compounds.
term.lms: LMS (labeled magnitude scale): an intensity scale from 0 to 100 with positions marked by words such as “barely detectable”, “weak”, “moderate”, “strong” and “very strong”; the marks are not evenly spaced.
